propositions: transition close appends the completion signature after releasing the lock, causing a transient lock timeout ~60s later to report as a failure with exit 0 while the close has already committed
the caller has no machine-readable field to detect that the close succeeded but the signature append failed, making the error undetectable programmatically
completion_signature payload with {signed, cause, error} fields must thread through all three public consumers: library rebar.transition(), CLI --output json, and MCP transition_ticket
the completion_signature key must be absent for non-close transitions and for idea->closed rejects, since those are not completion closes and should not invent a cause
the stderr message must state that the close LANDED and only the signature failed, not present the lock error as a failed close
